text:
MYPROTEIN x TWIX® Shortbread 

 Ingredients:
 Base
 2 scoops Myprotein x TWIX Impact Whey Protein
 1 cup almond flour
 2 tbsp honey
 1/3 cup coconut oil
 Caramel
 2 tbsp peanut butter
 1 tsp vanilla extract
 1/2 cup golden syrup
 1 tbsp coconut oil
 Topping
 100 g dark chocolate, melted

 Method:
Mix together the base ingredients together and press into a lined tray.
Mix the caramel ingredients until smooth and spread over the base.
Freeze for 30 minutes.
Pour over the melted dark chocolate.
Freeze for at least 1 hour before slicing and serving
Cut into 12 pieces
Macros: 
 248 calories 
 10g protein 
 21g Carbs 
 15g fat

MYPROTEIN x TWIX® PROTEIN PUDDING
This is a combination you need to try 🤤 @hanaliciouscoaching
 
Ingredients
30g Myprotein x TWIX Impact Whey Protein
160g 0% greek yogurt
5g dark chocolate crispies
60ml unsweetened almond milk
5g honey
 
Instructions
Whisk the protein powder into the almond milk until smooth
Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl and layered with the protein powder mix
Repeat for two layers
Top with the crispies and honey drizzle
 
Macros
Calories: 250kcal
Protein: 40g
Carbs: 14g
Fat: 3.5g
